run_fit_single_scene: run the fit_single_scene script to train a Lightplane NeRF model on a single scene dataset
run_evaluation: run the evaluation function to render test images and compute PSNR SSIM and LPIPS metrics
run_get_argparse: run get_argparse to parse command line arguments for fitting a NeRF model to a scene
run_main_training_loop: run the main training loop with voxel grid or triplane representation and ray or image rendering
review_evaluation: review the evaluation function that renders images from a pretrained field and saves visualizations
